overview: Local music store offering instrument sales, rentals, lessons, repairs, and classes for all ages.

history.notable history: Founded by Joe Clemmer as a traveling guitar lesson business, expanded to a storefront location in the Indian Valley community

inventory_focus.genres: various genres, including music lessons and classes for children (KidStart Music Classes)

events.types of events: music lessons, instrument rentals, and classes

staff.notable staff: Nate and Abbey Orlowski, descendants of the store's founder Joe Clemmer

community_role.description: supporting and strengthening the musical talents of the community through services
